data.description: Explicit board request (Claude Code chat, 2026-08-30, under the amended explicit-request rule): 'we should switch to websockets for messages.' Motivation: the web UI polls 3 endpoints every 5s and refetches full conversation history each time — fine on loopback, laggy over the board member's Tailscale link from his phone (relayed DERP path, high RTT), and it worsens as history grows. Goal: server pushes new messages to connected clients instead of clients polling. Design considerations for the planner (decide, don't inherit): (1) zero-dependency constraint — a raw RFC6455 websocket server on node:http is nontrivial by hand; Server-Sent Events (SSE) is trivially zero-dep, auto-reconnecting, proxy-friendly, and one-directional server->client, which is all that's needed since sends already POST over HTTP — weigh SSE seriously before hand-rolling websockets; (2) the 5s poll also drives roster status and unread counts — decide what moves to push vs what stays on a slower poll; (3) visibility discipline: pushed events must respect AS-6 hidden-channel gating per connected identity (no #board frames to non-members — byte-parity thinking applies to the event stream too); (4) coordinate with AS-23 (mobile layout) and AS-19 (threads rework) — same files, sequence deliberately; (5) delta fallback: even with push, initial load + reconnect catch-up should use a since=<last-id> param instead of full history. Acceptance sketch: new message appears on a second connected client without polling; hidden-channel parity holds on the stream; poll cadence reduced or eliminated; suite green in-container.
data.title: Chat: push message delivery (websockets/SSE) — replace the 5s full-refetch poll

data.body: Plan written (agent:cto-owen). Transport decision: SSE, overruling the literal 'websockets' wording with recorded rationale — SSE removes the hand-rolled RFC6455 protocol surface, gets EventSource auto-reconnect free (the dominant concern given iOS Safari kills background connections on any transport), and survives tailscale serve as plain HTTP with no Upgrade negotiation. Architecture: store-level post-commit onMessage hook (valid because AS-24 made the live server the single writer), per-connection visibleTo() gating evaluated per frame (hidden-channel nonexistent-parity extends to the stream — non-members get zero bytes), ?since= delta on /api/messages for reconnect catch-up, 5s poll replaced by push + 60s reconcile poll (roster/read-state drift). Plan file has walkable acceptance criteria incl. a two-client push test and a deterministic ordering-based hidden-channel stream-parity test.

Implementation complete (agent:developer-marcus), 3 commits on feat/AS-25-push-delivery: 39426f9 (store: onMessage post-commit hook from both write paths, visibleTo, messagesSince), 9084f18 (server: /api/stream SSE w/ per-connection visibleTo gating, 25s :hb heartbeat, ?since= flat delta, close() clears timer + end/destroys streams — wedge pinned by test), e07deb7 (client: EventSource + new pure module public/live.js applyMessage/maxLoadedId as the single merge path for frames/catch-up/POST echo; 5s poll retired, 60s sidebar-only reconcile). Suite 150/150 in-container (was 136; +14: 3 store, 5 stream.test.js, 4 live.test.js, 2 api). Guards: url-state/scroll/thread-modal files+tests zero diff vs master. Deviations from plan, both boring: (1) new client module live.js not in the plan's file table — extracted per house pattern (url-state/scroll/thread-modal) so catch-up idempotency is unit-testable; AS-17 rule followed (STATIC_FILES entry + served-over-HTTP test). (2) delta rows carry no replyCount — safe because a reply id always exceeds its root id, so a delta root's replies are always in the same delta; client normalizes and counts. Hand-walk (plan's manual list: two-window push, kill/restart catch-up, background/foreground, non-member zero frames in devtools, CLI-post push) NOT yet performed — needs a throwaway compose up; left for QA or a follow-up tick per reviewer preference.

QA review (agent:qa-priya), cold, on feat/AS-25-push-delivery (34e6404) vs master. VERDICT: PASS — all 6 acceptance criteria met; no inline fixes needed; recommend done + merge, with the post-merge hand-walk below.

CRITERIA (method → verdict):
1. Two-client push: stream.test.js/1 — two identities, raw SSE reader, frames asserted from content alone (id/body/refs annotated like REST). PASS.
2. Hidden-channel stream parity: their ordering-based test PASSES; I attacked harder — raw-byte capture as a non-member during a #board post shows the only non-comment bytes are the subsequent public frame (no body token, no conversationId, no comment-frame leakage; comments are only :connected and uniform :hb). Also delivery-time gating: identity connected BEFORE a private channel existed receives its frames once made a member; a never-member gets zero bytes of it. PASS.
3. Delta: exactly id>since, replies inline, annotated, no threads key; hidden channel with since= 404s byte-identically to nonexistent even with malformed since (gate before validation — verified store + HTTP). Edges: since='' coerces to 0 (documented ?limit= coercion), 1.5/-1/Infinity → 400, huge → 200 empty, since+limit → limit ignored (client never sends both). PASS.
4. Stream gating: unknown me → 404, missing me → 400; I verified the error envelopes are BYTE-IDENTICAL (body + content-type) to sibling endpoints' — existence-oracle discipline holds; never a stream on error. PASS.
5. Poll retirement: pin runs against served /app.js bytes and can genuinely fail (asserts EventSource wiring present, no ',5000)' anywhere, exactly one setInterval and it's >=30_000 — actual 60_000 sidebar-only refreshSidebar; sendMessage slice must contain applyMessage and no selectConversation//api/messages refetch). PASS.
6. Suite in-container: 150/150 (was 136, +14 as claimed), run TWICE — clean exit both runs, so close() reaps streams+heartbeat without wedging (their 5s-timeout wedge test also passes). Guards: url-state/scroll/thread-modal js+tests, index.html, style.css, cli.js all zero-diff vs master. AS-7 sentinel tests untouched and green. PASS.

DEVIATIONS (both accepted): (1) live.js module — house pattern (STATIC_FILES entry + served-over-HTTP test present, module is pure, unit-tested). (2) replyCount-free deltas — traced: reply id > root id ⇒ a delta root's replies are always in the same delta; client normalizes root to 0 and bumps once per NEW reply id; already-loaded roots keep the server count and bump only for new ids; live.test.js proves replay idempotency with a structuredClone deepEqual. Sound.

EXTRA ATTACKS (all pass): onMessage subscriber throw never fails the write (store test proves broken-first subscriber); 20x destroy-socket-then-post-immediately races — no crash, delivery to survivors intact; two streams same identity both receive; idle-connection heartbeat verified live (:hb arrives <27s, valid SSE comment, uniform). ingestEvent emits post-commit with the full committed row (tx now returns the row — correct ordering).

NON-BLOCKING NOTES (backlog-grade, none violates a criterion): HEARTBEAT_MS not injectable so cadence is untestable in-suite (I verified live); since=''≡0 and since+limit precedence are unstated in docs; backpressure unconsulted per plan default; no membership-revocation product path exists to exercise mid-stream revocation (visibleTo is per-frame, so it would be honored).

POST-MERGE HAND-WALK (restated from plan; needs a live compose up + phone): (a) two browser windows, two identities — post in one appears in the other with no poll in the network tab; (b) kill server mid-session, restart — EventSource reconnects, post-after-restart appears via catch-up; (c) background tab / lock phone, post from the other window, foreground — message renders and badges correct via visibilitychange catch-up; (d) non-member devtools open while a member posts to #board — zero frames; (e) docker exec CLI post — pushed to browser (CLI→HTTP→hook); (f) tailscale serve path specifically — confirm no proxy buffering delays frames (heartbeat format verified, buffering is environmental).
